scope: First reviewed semantic group: registered command intents and immediate dispatch, on published main and current working tree. No assertion of downstream behavior parity, complete UI actions or all possible application actions.

actions.label: Open smart scheduling
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Scheduling controls and their loaded/empty/error state are usable.
actions.required_variants: View transition, cached/fresh availability; accepting/writing a suggested event is a separate action.

actions.label: Open quick capture editor
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: A fresh capture editor is visible with no edit identity retained.
actions.required_variants: Previously editing versus fresh; submitting text differs from meeting audio capture.

actions.label: Request a day plan draft
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: The Today request is consumed and its draft/feedback is ready.
actions.required_variants: Only dispatch/request intent is reviewed here; downstream proposal production and approval remain to inspect.

actions.label: Open conversation import
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Inbox import/create controls are visible and usable; saving/importing is separate.
actions.required_variants: Already-open versus transitioned Inbox; source/validation/save branches need further review.

actions.label: Create and open a knowledge document
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: The new document is visible in its detail editor and its durable write result is observed.
actions.required_variants: This command creates a record, unlike commands that only open a form; empty/populated stores and persistence errors.

actions.label: Open web clip creation
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Knowledge clip creation controls are usable; fetching/saving a clip is separate.
actions.required_variants: Already-open versus transitioned Knowledge; URL fetch/error/save branches remain separate.

actions.label: Open new meeting note editor
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: A fresh note editor is visible on Meetings; committing the note is separate.
actions.required_variants: Existing editor state, current view, cancel and later persistence branches.

actions.label: Open model selector
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: The intended selector state and model/provider choices are usable.
actions.required_variants: Current selector state, provider/auth availability, filtering, selection and persistence are distinct branches.

actions.label: Toggle diff panel
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: The diff surface reaches usable content/empty/error or closed state.
actions.required_variants: Opening a lazy panel is not complete at a boolean flip; data loading, project absence and errors remain to measure.

actions.label: Toggle files panel
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: File controls reach ready/empty/error or closed state.
actions.required_variants: Project absence, tree size, filesystem/network loading and cancellation branches.

actions.label: Toggle preview panel
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Preview reaches usable content/empty/error or closes.
actions.required_variants: Preview loading/navigation and network lifecycle remain beyond the immediate dispatch.

actions.label: Toggle right panel
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: The requested right-panel surface/launcher is usable or closed.
actions.required_variants: Previous surface and current view, cached/fresh content and loading errors.

actions.label: Toggle tasks panel
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Tasks panel reaches ready/empty/error or closed state.
actions.required_variants: Current view, task volume, loading and failure branches.

actions.label: Open active project in editor
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Editor launch result/feedback is observed, or no-project feedback is visible.
actions.required_variants: Registered web palette action; thread project precedes active project; editor selection and launch errors.

actions.label: Open project chooser
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: The chooser is visible and usable; opening the selected project is a separate action.
actions.required_variants: No projects, existing projects, cancelled chooser; downstream project loading remains separate.

actions.label: Stash prompt or open stash menu
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: A nonempty draft/chips are stashed and cleared, or the empty-draft stash chooser is usable.
actions.required_variants: Empty/nonempty draft, chips, existing stash and persistence/recovery variants.

actions.label: Copy displayed pull request link
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Clipboard contains the displayed pull URL, or the panel/no-pull notice is shown.
actions.required_variants: Pull panel open/closed; loaded/missing pull; clipboard state.

actions.label: Copy displayed pull request number
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Clipboard contains the displayed pull number, or the panel/no-pull notice is shown.
actions.required_variants: Pull panel open/closed; loaded/missing pull; clipboard state.

actions.label: Open local server chooser
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: The local-server chooser is usable; launching/navigating a chosen server is separate.
actions.required_variants: Registered desktop palette action; server scan/list/launch/error branches remain to inspect.

actions.label: Toggle sidebar
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: The applicable sidebar reaches the requested visible state.
actions.required_variants: Current view, narrow/wide window, open/closed, stored preference; child lifecycle not exhaustively reviewed.

actions.label: Open task creation form
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Task form is visible on the Tasks surface; submitting the task is a separate action.
actions.required_variants: Current view, empty/populated project/task stores, cancel and invalid submission are separate branches.

actions.label: Create integrated terminal session
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: The server-created PTY session is selected and usable, or creation feedback is shown.
actions.required_variants: Registered web palette action; project/default directory, existing session and backend errors.

actions.label: Open system Terminal
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: The operating-system Terminal launch is acknowledged or an error is reported.
actions.required_variants: Registered desktop palette action; distinct from creating an integrated PTY.

actions.label: Toggle integrated terminal
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: The terminal panel is visible and reaches its session/empty/error state, or closes.
actions.required_variants: Session attach/replay/reconnect/network variants are required beyond the toggle callback.

actions.label: Continue active thread in T3
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: The controlled bridge acknowledges the created thread, or missing-project/bridge-error feedback is shown.
actions.required_variants: No active thread/project, project precedence, bounded transcript, bridge unavailable/error; actual external writes require their own safe fixture.

actions.label: Copy active thread link
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Clipboard contains the client-specific thread address, or the no-active-thread outcome is observed.
actions.required_variants: Web-origin versus desktop link format; no active thread; clipboard permission/unavailable states.

actions.label: Copy thread Markdown
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Clipboard contains the bounded transcript and the expected notice appears.
actions.required_variants: No active thread, mixed parts, large outputs/reasoning, Unicode and truncation; clipboard errors.

actions.label: Copy CLI resume command
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Clipboard contains the provider/session/project command, or the correct missing-session/no-active-thread outcome is observed.
actions.required_variants: Claude/Codex; project override/fallback/home; shell quoting; small/large offscreen and visible histories; clipboard availability. Headless browser memory clipboard differs from OS clipboard.

actions.label: Open thread import
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Import chooser is visible and usable; selection/import/commit are separate actions.
actions.required_variants: Provider/source tabs, empty list, permission/error state require later review.

actions.label: Create a thread or choose its project
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: A fresh thread is selected with a ready composer and durable result, or the required project chooser is usable.
actions.required_variants: Web has-projects chooser versus immediate creation; desktop new-thread behavior; no project, active project, writer errors.

actions.label: Pin or unpin the active thread
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Pinned state and ordering are reflected, with the writer result observed.
actions.required_variants: No active thread, pinned/unpinned, populated catalogue, conflict/persistence failures.

actions.label: Settle or unsettle the active thread
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Settled state, unread state and ordering are reflected, with the writer result observed.
actions.required_variants: No active thread, settled/unsettled, unread, active work and writer errors.

actions.label: Navigate to Automations
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Requested view reaches ready, empty or error state and is usable; setting AppView alone is not completion.
actions.required_variants: Initial/reused route; empty/populated and cached/fresh data; permission/load errors; client lifecycle and other entry routes remain to inspect.

remaining: Classify all binding search candidates, including tests/comments, lifecycle callbacks, pointer/context menus, field inputs and submit operations.
Review downstream loading, storage, network, completion/error/cancel/retry behavior for every registered intent and supported client.
Expand HTTP parameter/method/fallback, slash argument/provider/state, MCP operation and workflow/lifecycle branches into semantic actions.
Include user actions absent from command palette, settings changes, clipboard/OS integrations, background stream/reconnect and all supported client variants.
Measure complete actions against these boundaries; partial component/fixture results do not automatically accept a whole action.
